changes: Closed the six high-priority gap_analyze uncovered requirements by adding fail-closed receipt algorithm enforcement, tying dry-run/help policy to live command metadata, linking Authority worktree and planner-confirmation policy to runtime smokes, adding generated-output hygiene for gap_analyze, and fixing host-neutral Codex/Lattice adapter path casing plus entrypoint registry consistency.
usage: Run node bin/lattice.js gap_analyze to confirm Requirement coverage 100%, Test coverage 100%, Gaps: 0 high / 0 medium; run node bin/lattice.js validate --story=B-e3d9 for story evidence; run node bin/lattice-codex.js verify_codex for adapter evidence. Focused smokes live under npm --prefix packages/main run test:authority-client, test:lattice-cli-migration-smoke, test:worktree-policy-smoke, test:planner-unattended-smoke, and test:gap-analyze-input-hygiene-smoke.
expectedOutcome: From the user perspective, the former 6 high / 0 medium gap_analyze output should become 0 high / 0 medium, validate should pass with all verificationIntent entries covered, and host-specific Claude/Codex observations should stay advisory rather than overriding local Lattice evidence.
actualTranscript: Observed node bin/lattice.js gap_analyze reporting Requirement coverage 100%, Test coverage 100%, Gaps: 0 high / 0 medium; node bin/lattice.js validate --story=B-e3d9 passing with 15/15 verification intent coverage; node bin/lattice-codex.js verify_codex passing 6/7 with only the documented global-fallback heartbeat advisory; delivery reviewer signed 4 docs promises and 8 real-machine tests.
outcomeDiff: No user-visible mismatch remains: expected convergence and validation outputs match actual outputs. The only note is an advisory global fallback heartbeat warning that is explicitly not gate evidence.
limitations: This closes the six current high gap_analyze uncovered requirements and related evidence correctness issues; it does not claim the entire Lattice project is now fully production-grade or unattended-ready beyond the verified scope.
pitfalls: The long tail came from real REVIEW findings: global lattice vs local node bin/lattice.js materialHash drift, merge reintroducing legacy path casing, verify-entrypoints duplicating runtime ignore policy, and evidence commands that were not clean-worktree reproducible. Future agents should use local CLI evidence and keep test fixtures derived from registries.
